Integrations/Communication

Linq

Send and manage iMessage, RCS, and SMS conversations, attachments, phone numbers, payments, and webhooks through the Linq Partner API.

68 actionsAPI key

Connect Linq

What your bot can do in Linq

Looks up

  • Check Messaging CapabilityCheck whether a recipient can receive iMessage or RCS without sending a message.
  • Get AttachmentReturn metadata and current status for a Linq attachment referenced by a message.
  • Get Available NumberSelect an available Linq sending number, optionally for recipients or a line type.
  • Get ChatReturn one chat by ID, including participants, service, state, and health information.
  • Get Chat LocationReturn precise locations currently shared by contacts in a chat.
  • Get ExperienceReturn one Linq experience and preserve its dynamic action field definitions.
  • Get MessageReturn one Linq message by ID with its content parts, sender, actual and preferred transport, delivery state, reply target, and timestamps.
  • Get PaymentRead a payment's financial state, amount, customer handle, merchant details, and any customer-action URL.
  • Get Payment CredentialsReturn the complete, highly sensitive short-lived handoff used to reveal a ready payment's virtual card directly from the provider.
  • Get Payment Handle ConnectionRead the financial-consent connection status for a customer phone number or email.
Show 15 more
  • Get Payment ProviderRead the organization's onboarding status for a payment provider.
  • Get Payment RequestReturn one payment request's amount, lifecycle status, checkout details, and provider join keys.
  • Get PollReturn an iMessage poll's current options, voters, and distinct voter count.
  • Get Reputation AuditReturn a Linq line reputation audit created with explicit approval.
  • Get Webhook SubscriptionReturn one Linq webhook subscription by ID, including its callback URL, event and phone filters, active state, and configured…
  • List Blocked HandlesReturn phone numbers, email addresses, short codes, and sender IDs currently blocked account-wide from inbound and direct outbound…
  • List ChatsReturn one page of chats, optionally filtered by sending line or participant, with a cursor for the next page.
  • List Contact CardsReturn Linq account contact-card identity data, optionally for one E.164 sending line.
  • List ExperiencesDiscover Linq experiences and their dynamic action fields.
  • List Message ThreadReturn one page containing the origin message and threaded replies, starting from any message in the thread.
  • List MessagesReturn one page of messages from a chat, including content, sender, transport, delivery state, direction, reply target, and timestamps,…
  • List Payment RequestsReturn one newest-first page of payment requests for reconciliation, optionally filtered by lifecycle status.
  • List Phone NumbersReturn the connected Linq account's sending lines with line type, forwarding configuration, and reputation status.
  • List Webhook EventsReturn the webhook event types currently available for subscription on the connected Linq account.
  • List Webhook SubscriptionsReturn the connected Linq account's webhook subscriptions, including event and phone-number filters, target URLs, active state, and…

Takes action

  • Add Chat ParticipantAdd an external participant to an existing group chat.
  • Add Poll OptionsIrreversibly add recipient-visible options to an existing iMessage poll.
  • Block HandleBlock a handle account-wide from inbound and direct outbound messaging.
  • Cancel PaymentIrreversibly cancel a financial payment and close its virtual card.
  • Cancel Payment RequestIrreversibly cancel an unpaid payment request and its underlying payment intent.
  • Connect Payment HandleStart the financial-consent ceremony for a customer phone number or email so an agent can later pay on that customer's behalf.
  • Create ChatCreate or reuse a chat on an explicit sending line and send an irreversible recipient-visible initial message.
  • Create PaymentCreate or advance a real financial payment on a connected customer's behalf, potentially minting a single-use virtual card.
  • Create Payment RequestCreate a customer-facing checkout that can collect a one-time charge or start an auto-renewing subscription.
  • Create PollIrreversibly send a recipient-visible iMessage poll to an existing chat.
Show 33 more
  • Create Webhook SubscriptionCreate a webhook subscription for selected Linq events at a controlled HTTPS callback.
  • Delete AttachmentPermanently delete a Linq attachment and its stored bytes.
  • Delete MessageIrreversibly delete a message record from Linq.
  • Delete Webhook SubscriptionPermanently delete a Linq webhook subscription and stop its future event deliveries.
  • Edit MessageIrreversibly change recipient-visible text in one part of a message sent within the last 15 minutes.
  • Leave ChatLeave an iMessage group chat.
  • Mark Chat As ReadMark every message in a chat as read and send an irreversible read receipt.
  • Remove Chat BackgroundReset a chat's recipient-visible transcript background to the default.
  • Remove Chat ParticipantRemove an external participant from a group chat.
  • Request Attachment UploadReserve persistent attachment storage and return a 15-minute presigned upload URL.
  • Request Chat LocationPrompt a contact in a one-to-one iMessage chat to consent to sharing their precise location.
  • Revoke Payment Handle ConnectionIrreversibly revoke this partner's financial-consent grant for a customer phone number or email.
  • Send MessageSend one irreversible, externally visible message to phone numbers or emails.
  • Send Message to ChatSend one follow-up or threaded reply to an existing Linq chat using its established sending line.
  • Send Voice Memo to ChatIrreversibly send recipient-visible audio as a native iMessage voice memo bubble to every participant in an existing Linq chat.
  • Set Chat BackgroundSet a recipient-visible color, animated, or photo transcript background.
  • Set Up Contact CardCreate or replace a Linq contact card for a sending line.
  • Share Contact Card With ChatShare the connected sending line's active contact card with a chat.
  • Start Payment Provider OnboardingCreate a hosted payment-provider onboarding session for the organization.
  • Start Reputation AuditStart a potentially metered or limited reputation audit for a Linq sending line.
  • Start Typing IndicatorShow a best-effort recipient-visible typing indicator for about 85-90 seconds.
  • Stop Chat Location SharingStop a specific contact's inbound location share.
  • Stop Typing IndicatorImmediately clear the connected line's recipient-visible typing indicator for a chat.
  • Toggle Poll VoteIrreversibly send a recipient-visible update that adds or removes the connected line's vote on one option of an iMessage poll.
  • Unblock HandleRemove an account-wide messaging block.
  • Update ChatUpdate a group chat's display name or icon.
  • Update Contact CardUpdate the public contact-card identity for one Linq sending line.
  • Update iMessage App CardIrreversibly send a recipient-visible in-place update to an iMessage app card.
  • Update Message ReactionIrreversibly mutate recipient-visible reaction state by adding or removing a tapback, or by adding an iMessage sticker.
  • Update Phone NumberChange a Linq sending line's production forwarding configuration.
  • Update Sticker PlacementIrreversibly send a recipient-visible update that moves, resizes, or rotates an existing iMessage sticker on a message.
  • Update Webhook SubscriptionUpdate a Linq webhook subscription's callback, filters, active state, or routing-header names.
  • Verify Payment HandleSubmit a customer's single-use OTP to complete the financial-consent ceremony and authorize future payments on the customer's behalf.
